hypothesis: At least one of two causally implemented 15-minute bidirectional mechanisms—Swing/Heikin-Ashi alignment or fresh breakout plus visible-book pressure—has positive, non-concentrated, after-cost validation performance on SNDK, GOLD, or BRENTOIL after selection only on chronological development data.
decision: Pre-register the existing immutable-code Swing/Heikin-Ashi and breakout-pressure search families before the completed SNDK, GOLD, and BRENTOIL archives are audited or their strategy outcomes are inspected. Use exact venue-qualified symbols, completed-bar decisions, next-bar execution, measured visible-book costs at $75 notional, explicit latency stress, authentic funding, both long and short directions, 5x leverage capped by venue limits, 60/20/20 chronological development/validation/sealed-holdout windows, and no validation retuning. Keep GOLD conditional under separate growth-enabled and growth-disabled fee sensitivities because the official metadata omits its growthMode field. Do not access holdout metrics, grant execution authority, or change the running crypto portfolio from this experiment.
falsifier: The hypothesis is weakened or rejected when untouched validation is nonpositive after nominal costs, worsens materially under stress, has profit factor at or below one, lacks either direction without a predeclared market-structure explanation, or is dominated by one event or asset. The experiment contract itself is invalidated by incomplete checksums, source or code hash drift, validation-driven parameter changes, unreported trials, fabricated continuity across archive gaps, a single assumed GOLD fee state, accessed holdout metrics, or any execution-capable client.
limitations: Qualification proves exact current market identity and observable books, not profitability, fill quality, or continuous availability.
The archives are book-only and cannot reconstruct public trades, private queue position, passive fill probability, cancellations, or adverse selection.
Current account fee inputs applied to historical books are sensitivities rather than historical private fee records.
GOLD has no authoritative single growth-mode value in the observed metadata, so enabled and disabled results remain conditional rather than promotable fee truth.
The two families are prior mechanisms transferred to new markets; failure would reject these transfers, not every possible SNDK, GOLD, or Brent strategy.
Independent reference-account screens do not establish shared-portfolio diversification or capital-allocation value.
No strategy, order, position, execution scope, live process, or active portfolio configuration changed in this preregistration.
